→ Live Match Updates and Analysis
Cricket World Live Line provides the fastest and most accurate IPL live score updates, so you don't miss a single ball of your favorite team's match. Our app features live match commentary in both Hindi and English, making it easier for you to stay engaged with the game. Additionally, we provide in-depth analysis of each match, so you can keep up with the latest trends and strategies.

→ What's New & Different
Our app provides full coverage of cricket series, from live scores to commentary and match schedules. We also offer cricket predictions, session up-down pointers, and an attractive screen layout that enhances your viewing experience.

→ Live Match Details
Experience the thrill of a live cricket match from the comfort of your own device. Our app provides the fastest live cricket score updates, with ball-by-ball commentary and a live scorecard that automatically refreshes.

→ Fixtures
Stay ahead of the game with our categorized cricket match schedules, which are organized by date, series, and team. We also provide detailed information on upcoming and recent matches, along with summaries of finished matches and lists of all past and upcoming series.

→ Full Scorecard
Get detailed player stats, including runs scored, wickets taken, partnerships, and fall of wickets, all in one place. Our full scorecard makes it easy to keep track of your favorite players and teams.

→ Latest Points Table
Stay up-to-date with the latest points table for all major cricket tournaments, including matches won, matches tied, matches played, matches with no result, match points, and net run rate.

→ Coverage and Leagues
Our app covers all major cricket formats, including T20, ODI, and Test matches, as well as popular cricket leagues such as the Indian Premier League (IPL), T20 Blast, and The Hundred Men's Competition. We provide live scores, commentary, and scorecards for each match, so you never miss a moment of the action.
